title: A black screen appears when I share my screen in Teams
description: I'm trying to give a presentation, and when I share my screen the other side sees a black screen.

worklogs.description: GPU hardware acceleration was found to be enabled; suspected conflict with Citrix VDI.
Settings > General > 'Disable GPU hardware acceleration' was enabled, and testing was done after a Teams restart.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: I disabled the setting and restarted Teams. We tested it and the sharing looks fine now.

resolutionNote: GPU acceleration was disabled in the Teams settings, and screen sharing became stable in the VDI environment.
